references.title: DWDS: her
references.supports: No Wortzerlegung; Adverb 'von dort (nach hier)'; Etymologie: ahd. hera, an old adverb

notes.rationale: von den Dünen her, the direction toward the speaker. Whether the click unit is this adverb or the authored circumposition von … her is contested (#1241). DWDS gives no Wortzerlegung, so it is a bottom word, and indeclinable, so it has no Ending, not even ∅ (ADR 0051): the Root her alone.
